title: CI workflow job if: conditions: drop only the draft-state clause and keep the pull_request event alternative
answers: Why does the examples or R job get skipped on every pull request after the draft check was removed?
How do I let a CI job run on draft PRs without breaking its schedule or workflow_dispatch runs?
Why are the cross-version test jobs not running on any PR? Where is set-matrix gated?
Why is the Windows slow-tests job not running on my PR?
body:
Path: job-level `if:` conditions in .github/workflows/examples.yml, r.yml, slow-tests.yml (windows job), test-requirements.yml, uc-oss.yml and cross-version-tests.yml (`set-matrix` job). Each decides whether the job runs for schedule (mlflow/dev only), workflow_dispatch, or pull_request events.
Rule: Replace `(github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false)` with `github.event_name == 'pull_request'`. Do not delete the whole pull_request alternative. Keep the schedule, `github.repository == 'mlflow/dev'`, and `!inputs.windows_only` clauses unchanged.
Symptom: After the first draft-gate removal, examples, the Docker example job, R, Windows slow tests, skinny/core requirements, the uc-oss integration test and the cross-version matrix were skipped on every PR, draft or ready, because the pull_request branch was gone. Fixed in commit 0c1ce080ae.
Constraints: Applies only where a pull_request alternative exists. For `if:` shapes that are `github.event_name != 'pull_request' || draft == false`, removing the draft clause removes the whole predicate. A job that `needs` a skipped job is also skipped.
applies: Job-level if: conditions in .github/workflows that include a pull_request branch alongside schedule or workflow_dispatch.
says: Test suites are completely skipped on pull requests after enabling tests on draft submissions.
Allow automated integration tests and example jobs to run on draft pull requests.
Why are matrix testing and platform checks not executing on my pull request?
Scheduled test runs stopped triggering after adjusting pull request execution rules.
Integration checks are omitted on pull requests marked as ready for review.
search: When allowing CI jobs to run on draft pull requests, remove only the draft-state clause from job-level if: conditions while preserving the pull_request event check. Replace (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false) with github.event_name == 'pull_request', keeping schedule, github.repository == 'mlflow/dev', and !inputs.windows_only intact. Accidentally dropping the entire pull_request branch skips jobs—including examples, R, Windows slow-tests, test-requirements, uc-oss, and cross-version matrix—on all PRs, which also skips downstream dependent jobs. Applies to workflow files in .github/workflows containing pull_request alongside schedule or workflow_dispatch triggers; do not alter other event predicates.
